approved_note: Drafted by Claude on 14 Oct 2026 for the general category (Noemi's "I want recs regardless of the category"), not yet checked by Noemi. Every request is made up. The expected answers were written before running module 1 on them: what a shopper means, not what the rules happen to do. A long-tail product no rule lists (marked so in its notes) is expected to be placed by the open model, so the rules alone miss it.
